data.raw_text:
Manila Mayor Isko Moreno has threatened severe penalties and prison time for those who rioted in Manila outside the Malacañang Palace yesterday.

The mayor insisted that most of the rioters were individuals bussed in from outside Manila and agitated by organizers. He promises to track them down using Manila's many CCTV cameras and to make them pay.

Mostly clad in black and with their faces hidden behind masks, rioters stormed toward Ayala Bridge, determined to push past the line of anti-riot police guarding the road to Malacañang Palace last Sunday, hurling projectiles and setting fire to one container van.

https://t.co/580nQA76jU
